text: Recently divorced bank teller Sheila visits the department store Dentley & Soper's in the sales and, guided by the strange clerk Miss Luckmoore, [buys a flowing red dress|trigger|bringing something home]. A rash spreads across her chest, her washing machine breaks, and at night [she hears the dress moving in the wardrobe|images|clothes, jewellery and keepsakes]. The store will not take it back. After Sheila, the dress passes on, to a washing machine repairman and his fiancée, [harming every owner it reaches|rules|it passes to others].
